thread:
eli_csm: Quick heads up - MavenCare wants to run an APAC pilot starting Friday. They asked for a temporary accelerated egress path + allowlist to reduce RTT to our apac-sg edge. Can we carve out a 72h window and bump QPS to 2k for the pilot?

rowan_ops: Thanks. Do we have their CIDRs and whether they use mTLS or a proxy header? Any compliance flags (PHI)?

eli_csm: CIDRs: 150.101.200.0/24 and 150.101.201.128/26. They will route via a customer-managed proxy using standard TLS (no mTLS). They will send masked PHI in some requests (consented), so keep audit logs on. Renewal conversation in ~6 weeks, this pilot is a key indicator.

leo_infra: Marking note on PHI - need to ensure logs are retained per compliance addendum. Region pin to apac-sg preferred. 2k QPS is high; what's their expected token profile?

tess_se: They said mainly embeddings + short chat. Embedding calls ~3k/sec spikes but small payloads. Batching will help, but embeddings pressure is different. Could we set a per-route cap for embeddings vs chat?\n
rowan_ops: Good idea. We can do separate route caps: embeddings=2k qps, chat=500 qps. TTL 72h then auto-revoke. I'll draft the network snippet.

eli_csm: Please also add a header allowlist exception: they use X-Org-Id for multi-tenant routing, need us to honor it.

leo_infra: Noted. We'll need a support ticket and JIRA. Tagging @devops-bot to create the request and schedule change window during low-traffic hours.

devops-bot: New request created: RQ-8771. customer=mavencare, env=prod-pilot, region=apac-sg, routes=[embeddings,chat], qps_caps={embeddings:2000,chat:500}, cidrs=[150.101.200.0/24,150.101.201.128/26], header_exemptions=[X-Org-Id], ttl=72h, compliance=audit-log-retention-enabled. ETA: ~90m.

rowan_ops: Snippet for their network team and ops (shareable):

```
customer: mavencare
region: apac-sg
routes:
  - name: embeddings
    qps_limit: 2000
  - name: chat
    qps_limit: 500
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 150.101.200.0/24
  - 150.101.201.128/26
header_exemptions:
  - X-Org-Id
egress_ttl: 72h
compliance: audit_logs_retention:true
notes: TLS only (no mTLS). Monitor embedding latency and p50 chat latency.
```

tess_se: I'll push a canary route for embeddings with lower batch_size first, watch costs. Add an alert: embeddings error rate > 1% or p95 latency > 800ms.

leo_infra: Change applied to edge (RQ-8771 -> APPLIED). Auto-revoke scheduled. Warmup kicked off for KVcache and batching lanes.

rowan_ops: Legal looped in and approved the temporary exception for header handling and log retention.

eli_csm: MavenCare confirmed: "received config, will run load tests at 03:00 UTC and share perf traces." They asked if we can extend by 24h if tests succeed.

leo_infra: We can extend if capacity and ops agree; flag for renewal impact notes. I'll keep an eye on the quota pool.

eli_csm: Thanks team — I'll capture performance artifacts in the account health doc and flag renewal risk as 'pilot-dependent'. Please DM me if any regressions. :white_check_mark:
